sum: SVRN, Inc. engages in developing and driving adoption of the infrastructure behind the agentic economy. It helps individuals control their assets, their data, and the AI agents that act on their behalf. The company manages a digital asset treasury anchored by NEAR, driving commercial adoption of NEAR's products, and backing, building, and acquiring ventures that serve its mission. The company was formerly known as OceanPal Inc. and changed its name to SVRN, Inc. in August 2026. SVRN, Inc. was incorporated in 2021 and is headquartered in Somerville, Massachusetts.
